titulo: Me ignoring the low battery warning
caption:
Me ignoring the low battery warning

Me ignoring the low battery warning.

Phone batteries wear fastest near empty or full. Topping up a little and often is gentler than running one flat.

Send it to the friend who lives at 1 percent.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a window. A small amber block figure with white eyes stands on the left, facing a digital counter on the right that falls from 20% to 12%, 7%, 3% and 1%. Each time it shrugs with sleepy eyes and a bubble says later, in a bit, almost or one sec. In the last seconds the text changes from: me ignoring the low battery warning, to: battery: 1%. charger: upstairs. Its eyes go wide and it trembles, then it narrows its eyes at the camera.
